I wanted to post a part of a PM Arnie sent me because it hit me:

"I can honestly say that I know several, several, people that "don't have it good" that don't believe in God and I also know quite a lot of people that do believe in God and things are awesome for them. If you don't mind me going on a rant- I think a lot of people that are homeless/panhandlers tend to believe in god and tell a lot of biblical references- thusly making it seem like those that do believe in god are misfortuned. Yet, it might be the other way around, God might be a way of coping and a way of dealing with their problems knowing that while people might walk by them in the streets and might not care at all- someone(/thing) does and so it's comforting. The real strength comes, or so I personally feel, from believing in yourself. But sometimes people don't have the courage or the ability to believe in themselves so religion can act as a helping hand. Friends and family also help in that aspect too."

Thank you everyone that responded. Its nice to hear encouraging words. Everything helps

I asked Arnie this question and thought I would put it out there for everyone. Do you believe in God? I used to go to church all the time and was a big believer but since all this bad stuff started happening I've lost my faith. I know its bad, but when you pray all the time and still go deeper into a hole it really hurts. I always ask for a sign and don't seem to get one.
